builds.title: Human Review Design Framework
builds.final: A HUMAN IS A CONTROL ONLY IF THEY CAN CHANGE THE OUTCOME.

scenes.headline: HUMAN IN THE LOOP?
scenes.body: That phrase hides the part that matters.

scenes.headline: WHEN DO THEY SEE IT?
scenes.body: Before the decision, while it can still change—not after the consequence.

scenes.headline: WHAT CAN THEY SEE?
scenes.body: Evidence, uncertainty, alternatives and what the system actually did.

scenes.headline: WHAT CAN THEY DO?
scenes.body: Approve is not enough. Change, stop, escalate and record must be real powers.

scenes.headline: TIMING · EVIDENCE · AUTHORITY · ESCALATION · RECORD
scenes.body: Human presence becomes meaningful only when these controls work together.

scenes.headline: DESIGN THE REVIEW, NOT THE LABEL.
scenes.body: Test whether the reviewer can actually change or stop the outcome.

builds.title: Multi-Audience Meaning Architecture
builds.final: CHANGE THE LANGUAGE. KEEP THE TRUTH ANCHORED.

scenes.headline: ONE IDEA. MANY AUDIENCES.
scenes.body: Adaptation is useful only if the factual core survives.

scenes.headline: LOCK WHAT MUST NOT MOVE.
scenes.body: Numbers · names · uncertainty · negation · material facts.

scenes.headline: CHANGE THE EXPLANATION.
scenes.body: Register, context, examples and vocabulary may move for the audience.

scenes.headline: CHECK DRIFT SEPARATELY.
scenes.body: Fluency is not evidence that a rewrite preserved meaning.

scenes.headline: AN ANCHOR CHECK IS AN ALARM—NOT PROOF.
scenes.body: Consequential multilingual or domain communication still requires competent review.

scenes.headline: TRUTH FIRST. AUDIENCE SECOND. VERIFY THIRD.
scenes.body: Never let the rewrite become its own source of truth.

builds.title: Unserved Decision Discovery
builds.final: MORE INFORMATION DOES NOT FIX A MISSING DECISION SYSTEM.

scenes.headline: THEY HAVE INFORMATION.
scenes.body: But they still cannot reliably decide what to do.

scenes.headline: THE UNRESOLVED DECISION.
scenes.body: Name the recurring choice—not the content category around it.

scenes.headline: RECURRENCE · CONSEQUENCE · AMBIGUITY · FRAGMENTATION
scenes.body: Four signals make the missing decision structure inspectable.

scenes.headline: A SCORE IS NOT DEMAND.
scenes.body: It does not prove willingness to pay, product-market fit or solution correctness.

scenes.headline: BUILD THE DECISION PATH.
scenes.body: Turn scattered information into an accountable way to choose and act.

scenes.headline: FIND THE DECISION PEOPLE STILL CANNOT MAKE.
scenes.body: Then investigate whether a system—not more content—is what is missing.

builds.title: Manual Intelligence Engine
builds.final: AUTOMATE THE METHOD ONLY AFTER YOU CAN SEE THE METHOD.

scenes.headline: A PILE OF SOURCES IS NOT INTELLIGENCE.
scenes.body: The transformation happens through explicit gates.

scenes.headline: REGISTER THE SOURCE.
scenes.body: Issuer · version · source date · checked date · exact locator.

scenes.headline: SOURCE ≠ ANALYST CLAIM.
scenes.body: Interpretation gets its own object instead of silently inheriting provenance.

scenes.headline: UNVERIFIED STAYS OUT.
scenes.body: Verified requires a note; contradiction and uncertainty remain visible.

scenes.headline: SYNTHESIS FOLLOWS STATUS.
scenes.body: The brief cannot quietly promote unchecked assertions into findings.

scenes.headline: COLLECT → SEPARATE → VERIFY → BRIEF
scenes.body: Make the research method inspectable before automating any part of it.

builds.title: Service-to-Software Discovery
builds.final: MAP THE WORK BEFORE YOU AUTOMATE IT.

scenes.headline: DON’T AUTOMATE THE SERVICE.
scenes.body: Separate the steps first.

scenes.headline: THREE FUTURES.
scenes.body: AUTOMATE · KEEP HUMAN · REMOVE

scenes.headline: LOW-VALUE REPETITION FIRST.
scenes.body: Do not automate waste just because it repeats.

scenes.headline: PROTECT JUDGMENT.
scenes.body: High consequence, ambiguity and exception-heavy work can remain human-led.

scenes.headline: PROTOTYPE STABLE RULES.
scenes.body: Automation is a candidate disposition—not a deployment approval.

scenes.headline: SOFTWARE / HUMAN / GONE
scenes.body: A better workflow can contain all three.

builds.title: Does This Actually Deserve to Be Software?
builds.final: BUILD THE FORM THE PROBLEM EARNS.

scenes.headline: SOFTWARE IS NOT THE DEFAULT.
scenes.body: It is one form the problem may—or may not—earn.

scenes.headline: FIVE POSSIBLE FORMS.
scenes.body: SOFTWARE · SERVICE · DATASET · COMPANY · KEEP SIMPLE

scenes.headline: VALUE · BUYER · ADVANTAGE · MAINTENANCE
scenes.body: Then inspect judgment, durable data and scale.

scenes.headline: THE FORM SHOULD MOVE.
scenes.body: More expert judgment can point to service. Durable evidence can point to dataset.

scenes.headline: IS NOT MORE TECH.
scenes.body: It is the strongest appropriate system the problem can justify.

scenes.headline: KEEP SIMPLE IS A VALID RESULT.
scenes.body: A sophisticated evaluation can conclude that software is unnecessary.
